post.description: The core research call: pass a keyword slug from list_collection_keywords (or the keyword text / research page URL). Filter sources or cap rows per modifier to keep the response small; the related group alone can hold 2,500 rows.

keyword.description: Keyword slug from list_collection_keywords (e.g. american-airlines), the keyword text (American Airlines; lower-cased and hyphenated), or a pasted https://answerthepublic.com/{locale}/research/on/{slug} URL.

max_rows_per_modifier.description:
Keep at most this many suggestions per modifier, in the site's order (search volume descending within a modifier). Default: all rows. Coverage is reported partial when rows were dropped.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 5000.

sources.description: Return only these source groups. Default: all six.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
One Free Market Research keyword report: the search suggestions people type around a brand keyword, grouped by source (questions, prepositions, comparisons, alphabeticals, numbers, related) and modifier (can, why, vs, ...), each with Google monthly search volume and cost per click where the site has them, plus the suggestions added and gone since the previous snapshot. The data is a periodic snapshot (collected_at), US EN only. Keywords outside the free catalog are not_found; use list_collection_keywords to find valid slugs.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `additional_suggestions_count` | number | Suggestions the site holds beyond the free report, as stated by the API. |
| `collected_at` | string | RFC 3339 instant the snapshot was collected. |
| `keyword` | string |  |
| `language` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `region` | string | Google market the suggestions were collected in, as the API states it (us for the whole free catalog). |
| `slug` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string | Public research page for the keyword. |
| `sources` | object[] |  |
| `suggestions_count` | number | Total suggestions in the report across all six sources, as stated by the API (not reduced by the sources filter or row cap). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
